name: CLX - Admin LUXI Restream Channels v1

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: DEACTIVATED. Admin-gated. action='pull' returns watch links, RTMP ingest, per-platform readiness and a MASKED stream key. action='reveal_key' returns the raw key and is the only path that does. Read-only against Restream. The key is never persisted.

nodes.name: Fetch Channels
nodes.notes: OAuth2. url per channel is the public watch link; active means LINKED, not broadcast-ready.

nodes.name: Fetch Platforms
nodes.notes: Public. streamingPlatformId -> name. Fetched live so a new id cannot silently break the mapping.

nodes.name: Fetch Stream Key
nodes.notes: OAuth2. SECRET. Masked before it leaves this workflow unless action='reveal_key'. Never persisted.

nodes.name: Fetch Servers
nodes.notes: Public. Ingest servers; we take Autodetect.

nodes.name: Fetch Requirements
nodes.notes: Per-platform gates Restream cannot know about (TikTok follower minimum, YouTube 24h activation, Instagram RTMP support...). Unmet blocking requirements downgrade READY to ACTION_REQUIRED.
